articles.title: France sets presidential election date as Macron finishes final term
articles.summary: France announced its next presidential election will be held on April 18 and May 2, 2027, as Emmanuel Macron prepares to leave office after his final term.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: French President Macron hosted a G7 summit at Versailles and entertained US President Trump, but analysts note his grand diplomatic gestures have not always translated into lasting strategic gains.

articles.title: In pictures: The Palace of Versailles, Macron's beloved soft-power tool
articles.summary: Macron hosted President Trump at a state dinner at the Palace of Versailles during the G7 summit to celebrate the 250th anniversary of American independence.

articles.title: 'For sure': Macron to preach stronger Europe vision at G7 swansong
articles.summary: Macron hosted his last G7 summit as French president, advocating for European strategic autonomy and presenting his vision of a stronger, more independent Europe amid US policy shifts.
